Three of them carried no group at all and each drew its own one-row heading beside QSFP28, as though a console socket ranked with 32 line ports. Six other devices in the library already name this cluster `mgmt` - asr-9001, as5912-54x, as7326-56x, as7946-30xb, as7946-74xksb and both DCP-R units - and every one folds its management SFPs in rather than leaving them in a media group. `media` and `speed` move to the two placements, where devices_index.py indexes them for search exactly as it does group attrs, so nothing is lost by not having a group to hang them on","role":"management","term":"Port"},"psus":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"1+1","redundancy-note":"2x 650 W redundant, load-sharing, hot-swappable"},"index-origin":1,"role":"service","term":"PSU"},"qsfp28":{"attrs":{"media":"qsfp28","speed":"100g"},"index-origin":1,"role":"traffic","term":"Port"}},"kind":"device","manufacturer":"Edgecore","maturity":"modelled","model":"AS7726-32X","name":"as7726-32x","portfolio":{"family":"Ethernet Switch","line":"Data Center","series":"DCS204"},"profile":"networking","provenance":{"attrs":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet (Hardware/Performance/Power/Supported-Transceivers sections; power figures are min idle / typical 32x SR4 at 30 percent load, 25 C ambient)"},"chassis":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet (Dimensions WxDxH 43.84 x 51.5 x 4.35 cm; Weight 10.87 kg)"},"cpu":{"confidence":"datasheet","note":"datasheet says only 'Intel Xeon 4-Core'; model and clock (D-1518 @ 2.20GHz) from the live entity dump of a lab unit (dumps/arcos-openconfig-components.json)"},"led-cluster":{"note":"human-reviewed vs device photo"},"port-number-positions":{"confidence":"drawing","note":"drawing - CONFIRMED, not estimated.
